verdict.rationale: Mercury has no documented bulk export or offboarding feature, but users can pull their data through the REST API, which returns structured data: list all transactions, categories, merchants, customers, invoices and treasury transactions. Statements and invoices download as PDF, the CLI and MCP give scripted access, and there is a sync to QuickBooks, Xero or NetSuite, so leaving is feasible but takes self-built extraction. Missing for 10: a one-click full-account export, documented open formats such as CSV/OFX for bulk data, account-closure and offboarding guidance, and independent confirmation that a complete export works.
